Components

43 components, each with its live example, usage, props and allowed values, the CSS classes it renders and the tokens that re-skin it. Everything here is generated from dist/components.json, which tools and agents can read directly.

Core

  • Avatar

    Circular image or initials with optional decorative presence dot. Class contract: .rse-avatar.

  • Badge

    Small status pill with a dot. Class contract: .rse-badge--<tone>.

  • Button

    Action button (or link styled as one) with 3 variants and 3 sizes. Class contract: .rse-button. Accepts every native attribute and a ref.

  • Card

    Program/school card: media, eyebrow, title, description, footer. Class contract: .rse-card.

  • CtaBand

    A full-bleed call-to-action band: headline, one line of support and the caller's buttons.

  • Divider

    Horizontal or vertical separator, optionally with a centred label. Class contract: .rse-divider.

  • Hero

    The opening block of a page: eyebrow, the one h1, a lead, buttons and optional media in two columns that collapse to one.

  • Icon

    Line-icon primitive — the single source of truth for iconography. 24×24 grid, 2px stroke, inherits currentColor. Pass to Button/IconButton via icon. Returns null for an unknown name, so a typo fails visibly in review rather than rendering a broken glyph.

  • IconButton

    Icon-only round button. Class contract: .rse-icon-button. Accepts every native attribute and a ref.

  • Tag

    Accent chip on a pale tint with its paired ink. Class contract: .rse-tag--<hue>.

  • Testimonial

    A single static testimonial as figure, blockquote and figcaption. Never invent one: use example while the text is a placeholder.

Brand

  • BrandMotif

    The official "cubo impossível" motif — the brand's central visual idea, supplied by Sesc as vector artwork and split into six constructions. Defaults to one brand family per shape; hue="original" retains supplied colours. Never re-maps per theme. Invalid variants/hues return null.

  • MotifEngine

    The motif engine: builds impossible isometric shapes from lattice bars and cubes with declared crossings, and renders them as flat-filled SVG in any of the six palette families. A function library with no visual output of its own; MotifLoader and MotifPattern build on it. Also exported one function at a time.

  • MotifPattern

    A field of impossible shapes that fills its container (display:block, width and height 100%: the host sets the size). animate is 'none' (static, default), 'reveal' (cells fade in by --d stagger when the pattern scrolls into view; needs motion.js, never hidden without it) or 'ambient' (a slow breathing loop with a mandatory pause button). Text never sits on the cells: put it on a solid panel. An unknown shape or hue renders nothing. Follows the motion setting: reveal is opacity only and ambient is static when reduced.

  • PlatformEntry

    Co-branded entry point from a Rede Sesc de Educação surface into the Plataforma Sesc Sab.IA. One click from a marketing page to the platform's home — see docs/sabia-platform.md.

Forms

  • Checkbox

    Checkbox. A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-checkbox.

  • DateField

    Native date input styled to match Input, with an optional deadline pill for enrollment windows.

  • FileUpload

    Drag-and-drop document upload for enrollment paperwork, with an attached-file list and per-file removal.

  • FilterChips

    Pill toggle group for filtering program, level and unit listings. Use above a results grid, never as a form field.

  • Input

    Text field with label, helper text and error, wired for screen readers. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-input. Every other prop goes to the <input>; className goes to the field wrapper.

  • Radio

    Radio button — group several with the same name. A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-radio.

  • Select

    Native select with the system's field chrome. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-select.

  • Stepper

    Progress indicator for multi-step flows: enrollment, document upload, application review.

  • Switch

    On/off switch (role=switch). A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-switch.

  • Textarea

    Multi-line text field matching Input, with optional hint, error and character counter. Class contract: .rse-field + .rse-textarea.

Navigation

  • Breadcrumb

    Navigation trail with a non-link current page. Class contract: .rse-breadcrumb.

  • Footer

    Ink-surface site footer: brand block, responsive link columns and a legal note.

  • Menu

    Dropdown menu for navigation and actions: regional unit pickers, Programas nav sections, row actions. Closes on outside click and Escape.

  • Navbar

    Sticky site header: logo, text links and one call to action; wraps instead of overflowing (no drawer yet, roadmap P3.2).

  • Pagination

    Page navigation for long result lists. Class contract: .rse-pagination.

  • Tabs

    Pill tab bar for switching sections. Implements the ARIA tablist pattern: roving tabIndex, aria-selected, and Left/Right/Home/End keyboard navigation. The tab list scrolls sideways inside itself on narrow screens. Class contract: .rse-tabs, __list, __tab, __panel.

Feedback

  • Alert

    Persistent inline banner with a tone icon. Class contract: .rse-alert--<tone>.

  • MotifLoader

    Primary branded loading feedback for buttons, inline waits and whole sections. Generated motif pieces assemble and release; reduced motion uses a slower opacity-only build.

  • ProgressBar

    Determinate progress track exposed as role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max.

  • Skeleton

    Loading placeholder with a slow shimmer. Mirror the shape of the content that will replace it.

  • Spinner

    Compatibility wrapper for MotifLoader inline mode. Prefer MotifLoader for new loading feedback. Uses managed reduced motion, not a separate rotating ring.

  • Toast

    Transient notification card with a tone accent; announced as role="status", or role="alert" for danger. Class contract: .rse-toast--<tone>.

  • Tooltip

    Hover and focus label for a trigger (icon buttons, truncated text); dismissed with Escape. Class contract: .rse-tooltip.

Data

  • DataTable

    Rounded, card-surface table for schedules, unit lists, fees and program comparisons. Horizontally scrollable on narrow screens.

  • Stat

    A single impact figure with uppercase label. Compose 3–4 in a flex/grid band to show the Rede reach.

  • StatBand

    A full-bleed band of 3–4 Stat figures in a fluid grid, announced as a list.

Disclosure

  • Accordion

    Expand/collapse list for FAQs and long-form program details. Animated with grid-template-rows so panel height is automatic.

Overlay

  • Modal

    Centred dialog on a dimmed backdrop: traps focus, closes on Escape and returns focus to the trigger. Class contract: .rse-modal--<size>.

Layout primitives

Plain classes with no React wrapper, from components/layout/layout.css.

ClassWhat it does
.rse-clustera wrapping row (buttons, tags, meta) with one gap; or set --rse-cluster-gap.
.rse-containerpage width (--rse-container-xl) with the fluid side padding. --prose / --md / --lg narrow it to the matching --rse-container-* token.
.rse-eyebrowthe eyebrow label: Bold, uppercase, eyebrow tracking, primary colour — the only uppercase in the system (AGENTS.md, rule 3).
.rse-gridauto-fit columns, no fixed column count: as many as fit at --rse-grid-min (default 17.5rem), one column on a phone. Set --rse-grid-min / --rse-grid-gap.
.rse-sectionvertical rhythm between major blocks (--rse-section-y-md; -sm below md). Consecutive sections share one gap. A section with its own surface is a band (CtaBand, StatBand), not .rse-section.
.rse-stackvertical flow with one gap. --sm / --lg change the gap; or set --rse-stack-gap.
